reasons.plausibility: Substituting Ni with small amounts of Co to improve grain boundary strength in MnNiSi alloys without significantly altering magnetocaloric properties is scientifically reasonable.
reasons.testability: Measuring mechanical and magnetocaloric performance before and after graded Co substitutions is a clear, feasible method to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The proposed Co-doping solution and straightforward characterization approach provide a tangible path for researchers seeking to balance mechanical and magnetocaloric properties.
